'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mark VanDriel DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark VanDriel]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Maven Drell
* '''Deck name:''' Oh oh oh it's magic
* '''Username:''' MAVanDriel
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
